title: Ahan Shetty Begins Shooting Hindi Action Drama Sanki in Bhopal on October 30
excerpt: Directed by Tinu Suresh Desai and written by Gyanendra Vasudev, the Hindi film pairs a love story with large-scale action and is slated for theatres in the first half of 2027.
body:
• Ahan Shetty starts shooting the Hindi action drama Sanki in Bhopal on October 30, his first film after Border 2.
  • The film is directed by Tinu Suresh Desai, known for Rustom and Mission Raniganj, and written by Gyanendra Vasudev.
  • Sanki pairs a love story with raw, large-scale action; Pooja Hegde is reportedly the female lead.
  • Backed by We The People, Roaring River Productions and Pals & Peers Entertainment, the film is slated for theatres in the first half of 2027.

Ahan Shetty is back on a film set. The actor begins shooting for Sanki, a Hindi action drama, in Bhopal on October 30, with director Tinu Suresh Desai and a large crew already in the city overseeing final preparations, Bollywood Hungama reported.

What is known about the film

Written by Gyanendra Vasudev, Sanki is built around a love story, layered with raw and explosive action. The makers have kept the plot and Shetty's character under wraps, with more detail promised in the coming months. Desai's track record — the courtroom drama Rustom and the rescue thriller Mission Raniganj — points to a director comfortable staging both emotion and scale.

Filmfare reported that Pooja Hegde is the leading lady, though the makers have not yet formally announced the full cast or released a first look. The film is backed by We The People, Roaring River Productions and Pals & Peers Entertainment.

The Border 2 follow-up

Sanki is Shetty's next outing after Border 2, and the choice of project is a deliberate shift: from a war ensemble to a single-lead action romance in which he carries the film. A Bhopal schedule also continues Hindi cinema's recent pattern of shooting large action productions in Madhya Pradesh, where the state has courted film units with single-window clearances.

The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres in the first half of 2027. Expect the first look and cast confirmations once the Bhopal schedule is under way.

What to watch for

Three things will define how Sanki is read in the trade over the next few weeks. The first is the formal cast announcement: Filmfare's reporting puts Pooja Hegde opposite Shetty, and an official confirmation would immediately raise the film's profile. The second is the first look — the makers have released no poster or still, and for an action film sold on scale, the first image sets expectations. The third is the Bhopal schedule itself: a large crew shooting action in a state capital tends to surface in local coverage and social posts, giving the production free visibility long before a trailer exists. None of that guarantees the film, but it is the standard runway for a Hindi action release aiming at the first half of 2027, and Sanki is following it step by step.
